paper_type_evidence.quote: We describe an archival project using Cycle 0 data from the Atacama Large Millimeter/submilleter Array to survey the CO/CN line ratio in 17 nearby galaxies.

method.value: Inspect Cycle 0 projects for nearby galaxies observing CO 1-0; check cubes for CN S/N>3 over more than one channel

evidence.loc: 2.1 The ALMA Cycle 0 CN galaxy sample
evidence.quote: 8 galaxies showed significant CN emission across more than one velocity channel.

method.value: Integrated intensity maps with 2-3 sigma cutoff, only emission channels, after beam matching

evidence.quote: An integrated intensity map was made for each line using a $2-3\sigma$ cutoff and including only those velocity channels in which sufficiently strong emission was seen

method.value: Iterate CO moment cutoff at R_i x (2,3)sigma_CN, using CN channels and CN-clipped mask, until R converges (2-3 iterations); ratio of fluxes

evidence.quote: a second CO integrated intensity map was made, but this time using a cutoff equal to $R_1 \times (2,3)\sigma_{CN}$

validation.value: Convergence of R_i; tapered NGC 1377 test agreed with Table values

evidence.loc: 3.1 Observed variations in the CO/CN line ratio
evidence.quote: The global and S/N-matched CO/CN line ratios measured from this lower resolution map agreed extremely well
Signal-to-noise matched CO/CN ratios range from as low as 7 to as high as 65
while ratios using the total detected flux range from 20 to 140

findings_qualitative.value: CO/CN varies by more than a factor of 3 spatially in several galaxies; opacity and conversion factor unlikely to explain it

evidence.quote: We argue that the variations are unlikely to be due to differences in the opacity of either CO or CN

claims.hypothesis: Does the CO/CN ratio vary strongly between and within galaxies?
claims.experiment: S/N-matched and global ratios in 8 Cycle 0 galaxies
claims.finding: Large variations, likely abundance and/or excitation

evidence.quote: Spatial variations greater than a factor of 3 are seen in several galaxies.

claims.experiment: Compare ratios in 4 AGN nuclei with starburst regions
claims.result: 3 of 4 AGN show ratios 2-3 times larger
claims.finding: CN may be suppressed near AGN, in tension with XDR models

evidence.quote: 3 of the 4 active galactic nuclei in our sample show CO/CN line ratios that are roughly a factor of 2-3 larger

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: CN optical depth, CO optical depth, and CO-to-H2 conversion factor variations rejected as main cause

evidence.quote: or to changes in the CO-to-H$_2$ conversion factor in these infrared-luminous systems

how_they_decided_enough.value: Iterated until R_i close to R_i+1

evidence.quote: at which point the process was deemed to have converged

limitations_admitted.value: Agreement between flux-weighted and moment-map ratios not always good; VV 114 multiplier could not match global ratio

evidence.quote: We note that the agreement between the flux-weighted CO/CN ratio and the value measured from the ratio of the moment 0 maps is not always as good as for AM 2246-490.

referee_caveats_inferred: Iterative S/N matching is subjective and uncertainties are loosely estimated
No excitation modelling to separate abundance from excitation
